Senses.Explanation: An incense burner is the vessel in which incense and ash remain. Chan speakers point to the actual object, ask whether the assembly sees it, and use an old temple's cold burner flaming again as an image of renewed activity. The implement is concrete even when the sentence makes it work figuratively.

Senses.Note: One exact public-address witness supports the proper-place sense.

Senses.Explanation: Xianglu Peak is a named mountain peak, not an incense vessel. Sanyi Mingyu invokes measuring its height while staging an impossible public task, preserving the place-name inside a Chan address.
